items.title: OpenAI limits release of new model under pressure from US
items.description: The ChatGPT maker said that it’s introducing the GPT-5.6 model series to a small group of trusted partners whose names have been approved by the US government

items.title: How India's refineries helped cushion the economy from the West Asia energy crisis
items.description: India's demand for petroleum products has also grown significantly, with domestic consumption of petroleum, oil and lubricants (PoL) increasing to 243.2 million metric tonnes in FY26 from 90.6 million metric tonnes in FY1999.

items.title: ITC's consumer spending in FMCG business up 8.8% to Rs 37,000 crore in FY'26
items.description: Consumer spending on ITC's FMCG products has maintained a strong growth trajectory over the past three years, rising from nearly Rs 29,000 crore in FY23 to Rs 32,500 crore in FY24, reflecting a 12 per cent year-on-year increase

items.title: Byju's lenders seek 30% stake in Indian education group in settlement: Report
items.description: Byju's acquired India's Aakash in a $1 billion deal in 2021, but its stake has since been diluted to a minority, with Manipal Health now the single largest shareholder.

items.title: Magnus Steel completes Rs 60 crore transaction advisory mandate, posts jump in FY26 profit
items.description: The company has also received shareholder approval to shift its registered office from Nashik to Pune.

items.title: Apple supplier Tata Electronics tightens internal controls after data breach: Report
items.description: Tata has said it had identified a "cybersecurity incident" and there was no impact on operations, without providing additional details

items.title: NHAI plans ATMS infra deployment on National Highways in Delhi-NCR region
items.description: The upgraded framework incorporates several advanced features, including AI-enabled enforcement systems, automated video-based incident detection, centralised monitoring infrastructure and integration with digital enforcement platforms, it added.

items.title: Volkswagen layoffs: Audi, Porsche maker eyes cutting 1 lakh jobs, shut factories
items.description: The company is grappling with US tariffs, a persistent weakness in China and mounting competition in Europe.

items.title: Eli Lilly brings Rs 2.15 lakh cancer drug Tanstrive to India after CDSCO approval
items.description: Tanstrive is available in India in 40 mg, 80 mg, 120 mg and 160 mg tablet strengths and is administered orally twice daily. The drug is priced at rs 2.15 lakh per box, which covers a 14-day treatment regimen.

items.title: JPMorgan names Doug Petno, Troy Rohrbaugh co-presidents, sharpening Dimon succession planning
items.description: Jamie Dimon has led JPMorgan since January 2006, steering the bank through the global financial crisis and periods of significant market volatility. ​Investors have long speculated about when he might step ​down, and who would succeed him

items.title: Apple sharply hikes prices of Macs, iPad, Apple TV, HomePod in India, iPhones spared for now
items.description: Apple has not yet announced price increases for iPhones in India or globally despite the cost pressures. Analysts said Apple continues to shield iPhone prices for now, which is significant given that the device contributes more than half of its total revenue.

items.title: SETL acquires majority stake in GScale Energy, marks entry into AI Datacenter Engineering
items.description: The acquisition marks an important milestone in SETL's engineering expansion strategy, extending its decade-long expertise in concept-to-commissioning engineering solutions built serving the pharmaceutical, chemical, and biotechnology industries — into the rapidly growing AI Datacenter sector

items.title: Demand for gold jewellery coming back strongly as customers adjust to 9% customs duty rise: Indriya CEO
items.description: Falling gold prices buoy demand, Aditya Birla Group-backed jewellery retailer plans to reach 120 stores in FY27

items.title: Government readies diesel biofuel push; Tata Motors to begin isobutanol-blend trials next quarter
items.description: After achieving the E20 petrol blending target, India is preparing to introduce isobutanol blending in diesel, a move that could significantly impact the commercial vehicle sector and energy security

items.title: A red hot summer for AC manufacturers, retailers but demand flattens in June
items.description: Robust double-digit growth in AC sales in April and May fizzled out in June as the monsoon set in, manufacturers and industry analysts tell Moneycontrol

items.title: Tata Motors, Stellantis on verge of finalising partnership
items.description: Discussions under an existing MoU are nearing completion, the Indian automaker said. Tata Motors also said its upcoming Avinya luxury EVs will be developed on the Chery-backed Freelander architecture via JLR

items.title: Spinny signs on as title sponsor for India vs Ireland T20I Series
items.description: The series is scheduled within a packed 2026 international window for both cricket boards, and follows India's past tours to Belfast as part of efforts to grow the game's footprint in Ireland.

items.title: Sony India sees H2 recovery, banks on premium TVs and audio to sustain growth around festive period
items.description: The company expects to maintain double-digit value growth in FY27, driven by premium televisions, home audio systems, gaming products, cameras and personal audio devices, even as industry volumes remain under pressure as consumers defer discretionary purchases.

items.title: FMCG’s new ad battlefield: Why Nestle, Dabur and HUL are chasing quick commerce shoppers
items.description: As the ratio of sales from quick commerce platforms rises, ad spends on the platforms are going up in tandem with large FMCG companies now directing at least 5-6 percent of their total advertising expenditures specifically toward quick commerce channels

items.title: Noel Tata, who turns 70 in November, to step down as Trent chairman
items.description: According to Tata Group's governance policies, executive directors have a retirement age of 65, while non-executive directors retire at 70

items.title: Satin Creditcare – Can sectoral tailwinds bring depressed valuations to life?
items.description: Sector recovery, stronger profitability, and attractive valuations create room for re-rating

items.title: Vedanta eyes $372 million raise from Zambia copper mines IPO
items.description: The offering, if it goes ahead, will reduce Vedanta’s interest in CopperTech to at least 88.1%.

items.title: Railway Ministry accepts IRCTC CMD Sanjay Kumar Jain's resignation, to relieve him from post on July 20
items.description: IRCTC CMD Sanjay Kumar Jain will continue in the post until July 20. He joined IRCTC as CMD in February 2024 and served the organisation for more than two years.

items.title: Honasa acquires 58% stake in Fluence Pharma, enters nutraceuticals segment
items.description: With the acquisition, the Mamaearth parent will launch a dedicated subsidiary Honasa Health. Fluence reported Rs 40 crore revenue and over 20% EBITDA margin in FY26
